g.text: KESTREL K1 — Stage-2 ring gear blank z54 m1.25
Material: 18CrNiMo7-6 · Process: turn, shape/wire-EDM teeth, carburise, grind
Tolerances: ISO 1328 grade 6 · Finish: case 0.6-0.8 mm, 58-62 HRC
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
